description:
Restore closure-identity stability for event handlers inside :for comprehensions, regressed by 1.4.7's drop-of-memo workaround.

The legacy do_walk in assign_and_emit detected for-loops containing register_event_handler and wrapped the entire for-loop with memo_at keyed on outer-scope vars. Cache hit replays the registered handler range from previous fiber state, returning the cached list of vnode tree fragments. Closure identity stays stable when outer-scope deps don't change; new closures only mint when deps change.

Port that to vnode IR.

## Files
- lib/filament/vnode_compiler.ex (assign_memos_vnode → comprehension-aware walker)

## TDD
1. Re-enable the closure-identity test in test/filament/vnode_engine_memo_test.exs.
2. Add a 'closures rebuild when items prop changes' test.
3. Add a 'per-iteration capture is correct' regression test for the bug found in 1.5 Chrome validation.

## Acceptance
- Re-enabled closure-identity test passes.
- Cart example: clicking different products adds correct items across multiple re-renders (no regression of the 1.5 bug).
- 380+ tests green.
title: Phase 1.5.1: Comprehension-aware closure memoisation for vnode IR
